newsitem.title: USA: Illinova says weather, outage hurt Q2.
newsitem.headline: Illinova says weather, outage hurt Q2.

text.p: Illinova Corp said Friday that second-quarter results were shaped in part by mild weather conditions and an outage at its nuclear Clinton Power Station.

While those factors contributed to lower profits on the quarter compared to the prior-year period, Illinova said, they were "partially offset by timing of fuel cost recoveries under the Uniform Gas Adjustment Clause, through which the company collects its gas costs."

The power utility reported second-quarter net income of $31.4 million, or $0.42 per share, on revenues of $542.9 million, compared to net income of $36.7 million, or $0.48 per share, on revenues of $373.4 million in the previous year.
